title: JointServe: Serving Multi-Model Agents on Memory-Constrained GPUs
abstract: arXiv:2610.19822v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents are evolving from a single model calling tools to planners that orchestrate multiple expert models whose capabilities live in distinct weights. This shift breaks a hidden assumption of today's serving systems: that the working set of models fits in GPU memory. On the memory-constrained GPUs typical of private and edge deployments, naive whole-model swapping serializes weight transfer with computation and, without host-backed KV restoration, discards session state at a switch. We present JointServe, a serving system that treats weight shards and KV blocks as residency objects competing for one unified memory budget. translated_title: JointServe：在内存受限GPU上服务多模型智能体
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体正在从调用工具的单一模型，演变为协调多个专家模型的规划器，而这些专家模型的能力分别存储于不同的权重之中。这一转变打破了当今服务系统的一个隐含假设：即模型的工作集能够完全容纳于GPU内存。在私有部署和边缘部署中常见的内存受限GPU上，朴素的整模型交换方式会使权重传输与计算串行化，并且在缺乏主机端KV恢复支持的情况下，每次切换都会丢弃会话状态。我们提出JointServe，一个将权重分片和KV块视为在统一内存预算中竞争的驻留对象的服务系统。JointServe利用智能体工作负载的三个结构特性（有向调用、间隔执行和双状态驻留）在模型被调用之前做好准备：从调用者自身输出流中解析出的意图信号在生成过程中触发预取，部分k*驻留将切换过程缩减为增量...
tldr: JointServe通过将权重分片与KV块统一纳入同一内存预算进行管理，并利用意图信号预取和部分驻留等智能体工作负载的结构特性在模型被调用前完成准备，从而在内存受限GPU上实现了多模型LLM智能体的高效服务。
en_tdlr: JointServe enables efficient serving of multi-model LLM agents on memory-constrained GPUs by treating weight shards and KV blocks as residency objects under a unified memory budget, and exploiting structural properties of agent workloads (such as intent-triggered prefetch and partial residency) to prepare models before they are invoked.
